title: Sentinel Client
description: A client-side utility mod with toggleable QoL modules
body:
# Sentinel > A highly lightweight, client-side utility mod for Fabric providing over 30 quality-of-life and visual modules within a unified, modern interface. ![Sentinel Menu Preview - Module overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7d39f7fb8be4cf7d53624d2960335c98ea07118.png) --- ## 🧩 Module Directory *Click on a category below to expand and view the available modules. Categories match the in-game menu.*

👁️ Visuals

 | Module | Description | |:---|:---| | **Zoom** | Hold a key to zoom; utilize the scroll wheel for precise magnification steps. | | **Freecam** | Detach the camera to fly freely while your player entity remains stationary. | | **Freelook** | Freely observe your surroundings in third-person without altering player rotation. | | **Fullbright** | Overrides gamma settings to provide maximum visibility in dark environments. | | **Hide Armor** | Disables rendering of individual armor pieces on your player model. | | **Hitbox** | Custom hitbox rendering with target highlights and line-of-sight indicators. | | **Hit Color** | Replaces the vanilla red damage overlay with a custom, configurable tint. | | **Crosshair Indicator** | Shows a custom crosshair sprite when aiming at an entity. | | **ClearVision** | Disables water, lava, and powder snow overlays; removes blindness and darkness fog. | | **Low Fire** | Reduces the vertical height of the fire overlay in the first-person perspective. | | **Lower Shield** | Adjusts the shield rendering position in the first-person view for better visibility. | | **Smaller Totem** | Reduces the visual scale of both the held Totem of Undying and its activation animation. | | **Day Changer** | Overrides the client-side time of day (e.g., perpetual day or night). | | **Health Indicator** | Renders precise numerical health values directly above players and mobs. | | **TNT Timer** | Overlays a precise countdown timer above primed TNT entities. |

📊 HUD Widgets

 | Module | Description | |:---|:---| | **HUD Editor** | An intuitive drag-and-drop interface to scale and freely position all HUD elements. | | **Nutrition HUD** | Displays numerical hunger, saturation, and exhaustion alongside exact food tooltips. | | **Status Effect Bars** | Visualizes active status effects via a clean, minimalist icon bar array. | | **Armor Status** | Displays currently equipped armor pieces and their remaining durability. | | **Scoreboard** | Customizable scoreboard styling — colors, borders, and transparency. | | **Character Renderer** | Projects a live preview of your player model directly onto the HUD. | | **Centered Crosshair** | Pixel-accurate centering for the vanilla crosshair. | | **Shulker Box Insides** | Hold Shift to inspect shulker box contents via a 3×9 grid directly in the tooltip. | | **Beehive Infos** | Adds occupant age status (young/grown) directly into beehive and nest tooltips. | | **FPS / CPS / Ping** | Lightweight performance overlays. | | **Keystrokes** | Displays your current movement and click inputs. | | **Coordinates / Server IP** | Quick-glance world position and connection info. | | **Reach Display** | Shows your current attack/interaction reach distance. |

🎮 Controls

 | Module | Description | |:---|:---| | **Auto Sprint** | Automatically engages the sprint state upon forward movement. |

🛠️ Convenience

 | Module | Description | |:---|:---| | **Auto Reconnect** | Automatically attempts to reconnect to the previous server after a disconnect, with a configurable delay. |
Every module is individually toggleable, fully customizable, and can be bound to its own keybind — press Right Shift in-game to open the menu. --- ## 📋 Requirements | Dependency | Status | Description | |:---|:---|:---| | **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** | Required | Essential hooks for mod compatibility. | | **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** | Optional | Recommended for accessing configurations via the pause screen. | --- ## 🐛 Support & Feedback If you encounter an issue, discover a bug, or have a feature request, please submit a report on our community server.
